# ===================================================================
# GOOD STYLE EXAMPLES
# ===================================================================
# This file demonstrates CORRECT CK3 scripting style and formatting.
# All examples in this file should PASS validation with NO errors.
#
# What this tests:
# - Proper indentation (tabs, not spaces)
# - Correct operator spacing (= >= <=)
# - Namespace at top of file
# - Proper brace alignment
# - Reasonable line length
# - Appropriate nesting depth
# - No trailing whitespace
#
# Expected validation result: NO ERRORS
# ===================================================================

# Namespace should be at the top of the file
namespace = style_good

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Example 1: Proper spacing, indentation, and structure
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT THIS TESTS: Overall formatting best practices
# SHOULD PASS: Yes - follows all style conventions
# DEMONSTRATES: Tab indentation, proper spacing, clean structure
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
style_good.0001 = {
	type = character_event
	title = style_good.0001.t
	desc = style_good.0001.desc
	theme = intrigue

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
		is_ruler = yes
		gold >= 100
	}

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = actor
		add_gold = 100
	}

	option = {
		name = style_good.0001.a
		add_prestige = 50
	}

	option = {
		name = style_good.0001.b
		add_piety = 25
	}
}

# Proper operator spacing (space around = and >=)
style_good.0002 = {
	type = character_event
	title = style_good.0002.t
	desc = style_good.0002.desc

	trigger = {
		age >= 16
		gold >= 100
		prestige >= 50
		is_adult = yes
		is_ruler = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = style_good.0002.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# Proper indentation with tabs
style_good.0003 = {
	type = character_event
	title = style_good.0003.t
	desc = style_good.0003.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
		OR = {
			has_trait = brave
			has_trait = ambitious
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				gold >= 100
			}
			add_prestige = 50
		}
		else = {
			add_piety = 25
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = style_good.0003.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# Proper closing brace alignment
style_good.0004 = {
	type = character_event
	title = style_good.0004.t
	desc = style_good.0004.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	} # Aligned with trigger

	option = {
		name = style_good.0004.a
		add_gold = 100
	} # Aligned with option
} # Aligned with event declaration

# One statement per line
style_good.0005 = {
	type = character_event
	title = style_good.0005.t
	desc = style_good.0005.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
		is_ruler = yes
		gold >= 100
	}

	option = {
		name = style_good.0005.a
		add_gold = 100
		add_prestige = 50
		add_piety = 25
	}
}

# Reasonable line length (not too long)
style_good.0006 = {
	type = character_event
	title = style_good.0006.t
	desc = style_good.0006.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
		is_ruler = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = style_good.0006.a
		add_character_modifier = {
			modifier = ambitious_leader
			years = 10
		}
	}
}

# Proper nesting depth (not too deep)
style_good.0007 = {
	type = character_event
	title = style_good.0007.t
	desc = style_good.0007.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
		OR = {
			has_trait = brave
			has_trait = ambitious
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = style_good.0007.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# Blank lines between major sections
style_good.0008 = {
	type = character_event
	title = style_good.0008.t
	desc = style_good.0008.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = actor
	}

	option = {
		name = style_good.0008.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# Non-empty blocks
style_good.0009 = {
	type = character_event
	title = style_good.0009.t
	desc = style_good.0009.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = style_good.0009.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# Proper scope references (not truncated)
style_good.0010 = {
	type = character_event
	title = style_good.0010.t
	desc = style_good.0010.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = actor
		liege = {
			save_scope_as = my_liege
		}

		scope:my_liege = {
			add_gold = 100
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = style_good.0010.a
		add_prestige = 50
	}
}

# Decision with good style
style_good_decision = {
	picture = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_misc.dds"
	desc = style_good_decision_desc

	is_shown = {
		is_ruler = yes
	}

	is_valid = {
		gold >= 100
	}

	effect = {
		remove_short_term_gold = 100
		add_prestige = 200
	}

	ai_check_interval = 60

	ai_potential = {
		always = yes
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 100
	}
}

# Scripted effect with good style
style_good_effect = {
	every_vassal = {
		limit = {
			is_adult = yes
		}
		add_opinion = {
			target = root
			modifier = grateful_opinion
		}
	}
}
